== Service claim: resolved ==
Resolved 14 October 2026. Bill confirmed that Reitzel worked for Decipher. The article now cites his LinkedIn profile (Tradeshow & Event Coordinator, Decipher Inc., January 1999 – January 2005; the Internet Archive refused a capture). It also cites a TheOneRing.net post of 29 October 2001 signed as Decipher's Product Champion Coordinator (Wayback copy). Further sources: the KendallCast interview of 14 December 2023 (Wayback copy) and the existing ''Jedi Knights'' rulebook credit. These are in Service rows and in the lead sentence. Not yet cited: Radio Free Decipher episode 3 (18 December 1998, "new team member"). Also episodes 34 (March 2000, Young Jedi demo tour of Western Canada) and 63 (January 2001, Young Jedi spoilers). They are listed on the LOTR-TCG wiki; no archived copy was found. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 12:44, 14 October 2026 (UTC)
